steps.content: Your desperate resistance buys you only a sliver of space to retreat.
Pant... Pant... Pant...
You gasp, lungs burning. Pushing your shackles to their limit has left you even weaker—your mind more scattered, more fragile.
[Screen Shakes]

The figure before you stands bathed in crimson light, slowly consumed by the sea of flowers. And the gazes, the same ones that have haunted you from the darkness, break free from their fetters and resurface once more.
They are everywhere. Malicious. Mocking. Covetous. Prying. In that instant, you feel as though all the malice in the world has fixed its eyes upon you.

steps.speaker: Phantoms
steps.content: Life and death... a single breath between. A whisper tears the veil. You know this.

The voices whisper, sliding past your ears like silk through a keyhole. And from the darkness, mist the color of bruised teal writhes toward you, winding around your body and seeking any passage into the fragile fortress of your mind.
Offer no glance to the departed. Lend no ear to the abyss. Speak no question to the spirits...
You recite the warnings like prayers, blood-written and desperate. You press your palms hard against your ears, shutting them out, shutting them all out.
But still, they seep through.

steps.speaker: Phantoms
steps.content: Fight not... Your feet carried you here. Fate carries you home.

steps.speaker: Phantoms
steps.content: Find your own road back. Follow what calls... O soul, return!
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: My dear, fate is guiding you. You are destined to return to the origin, to return to my side. Go and see the shape of truth...
[End of Flashback]
Your heart convulses, and your shackles shatter their last restraints. Savage crimson thorns burst from your flesh, spearing through you, nailing you to the moment of your undoing.
Agony lances through every nerve. The world bleeds black as your knees find earth. And in that darkness, you feel them coming—the shadows, viscous and cold, surging forward to swallow what remains.
Tinkle—!
[White Screen Shakes]

A bell rings. Clear as ice, sharp as a blade. White light erupts through the darkness, and the very fabric of this nightmare trembles. The crawling horrors crack, splinter, and fall away like sheets of painted glass.
Let the flood wash all stain, cleanse the crossing to the beyond...
[CG Begins]

Within the glimmering haze, a figure takes shape: a woman in a cyan robe. She holds a silver bell aloft, swaying as she chants, her voice a quiet stream through the chaos. Her sleeves drift like wings resting.
And from her, light emanates, not harsh, but purifying. The air itself grows still around her, as if heaven and earth have agreed that here, in this small space, only what is sacred may remain.
The height of Yang, to Yang be called; the depth of Yin, let Yin be thralled...

Life flows back into your limbs. Your vision sharpens, the world resolving from chaos into form. The headache, the nausea, the creeping madness... all of it dissolves in that gentle radiance, leaving behind a sense of relief you had forgotten you could feel.
She turns toward you. A few strands of long hair sway gently beside her cheek, revealing a pair of clear, cyan eyes.
...Who... are you?
